ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to enforce sequential OCV event versions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNULL(PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c))), OR( OCV_Event_Version__c < PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c), ISNULL(OCV_Event_Version__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid version update. Version number should be sequential.
